glosses: The field of accounting concerned with the summary, analysis and reporting of financial transactions related to a business.
A non-physical asset whose value is derived from a contractual claim, such as bank deposits, bonds, and participations in companies' share capital.
Financial statements.
Financial institutions, as a group, such as banks and insurance companies.
Shares in financial companies.
A formal record of all relevant financial information of a business, person, or other entity, presented in a structured and standardized manner to allow easy understanding.
Any of the four basic elements in above, i.e. balance sheet, income statement, cash flow statement and statement on changes in equity.
Synonym of fiscal year.
A method of inventory accounting that values items withdrawn from inventory at the cost of the oldest item assumed to remain in inventory.
A policy of assigning priority to tasks and assignments that have arrived for service first.
A type of queue data structure in which the oldest added items are retrieved first.
An accounting period of one year, not necessarily coinciding with the calendar year.
Asset or property which cannot easily be converted into cash, such as land, buildings and machinery.
A cost of business which does not vary with output or sales; an overhead.
vi_hint: Chi phí cố định; định phí.

glosses: A variable whose value depends on a period of time rather than an instant, example being the gross domestic product.
vi_hint: Biến số mang tính dòng chảy.

glosses: A type of specialist accounting for the purpose of engaging in a legal dispute over insurance, fraud, etc.
Financial resources.
Permanent debts due by a government and paying interest.
The central accounting record of a company or organization consisting of the accounts that support the value items shown in the major financial statements.
A successfully operating enterprise.
A person who is active, thriving, energetic, and highly successful in their endeavors.
The difference between net sales and the cost of goods sold.
The total invoice value of sales, before deducting customers' discounts, returns, or allowances.
The original nominal monetary value of an economic item; the value at which an item was acquired by a company and was entered in its books.

A calculation which shows the profit or loss of an accounting unit (company, municipality, foundation etc.) during a specific period of time, providing a summary of how the profit or loss is calculated from gross revenue
vi_hint: Báo cáo kết quả (của hoạt động kinh doanh)

glosses: Any cost that is not directly accountable to a cost object (such as a particular project, facility, function, or product). They include administration, personnel and security costs.
What an industry produces, as a national total.
